name: counter-script
source:
# A transaction script that increments the counter of the account that runs
# it. It calls the counter's procedures, so it needs them: add your
# counter-account script as a dependency.

use counter_account

#! Increments the executing account's count by one.
#!
#! Inputs:  []
#! Outputs: []
@transaction_script
pub proc main()
    # `call` runs an account procedure on the top 16 elements of the stack,
    # and puts its 16 outputs in their place
    call.counter_account::increment_count
    # => [new_count, pad(15)]

    # the new count isn't needed
    drop
    # => [pad(16)]
end
